installerExecutable.blockerDetail: The artifact download endpoint (api.github.com .../artifacts/<id>/zip) returns an HTTP 302 to productionresultssa32.blob.core.windows.net, which is not on this sandbox's egress allowlist and returns no response. objects.githubusercontent.com is likewise unreachable. The installer executable therefore could not be extracted, hashed, or compared against its evidence manifest here.
installerExecutable.criticalDistinction: The 2b6bfaf5... digest in installerArchive is the SHA-256 of the *ZIP archive bundling the .exe*, not of the .exe itself. It must never be published or cited as the installer binary checksum.

knownLimitations: Installer is unsigned. SmartScreen 'Unknown publisher' warning is expected on the pilot build.
Cross-version installer upgrade (0.3.0 -> any other version) is untested and out of pilot scope.
Clean-PC offline WebView2 bootstrap when the runtime is entirely absent is unverified on physical hardware; the bundle uses the offline WebView2 installer but no physical machine test exists.
Real thermal receipt printing, real A4 printing, real Gurmukhi paper output, real USB barcode scanning and USB backup media durability are ALL UNTESTED physically.
No main-triggered (push-triggered) Windows workflow run exists. The only Windows evidence is PR-triggered on a tree-identical commit.
Rust toolchain and Cargo crate versions are not pinned, so a future rebuild is not bit-for-bit reproducible.
Multi-PC LAN, GST statutory invoicing, automated UPI/card settlement verification and public commercial distribution are explicitly out of scope.
Artifact bodies are unreachable from this environment; installer executable SHA-256 is unverified.

automatedWindowsReleaseCandidate.rationale: A Windows NSIS build with SQLCipher, UIA and installer lifecycle evidence exists and its job concluded success on a tree byte-identical to main. It is not unconditional because (a) provenance is PR-bound rather than main-triggered, (b) the archives expire 2026-11-09 and are not durably archived, and (c) the installer executable SHA-256 could not be verified against its evidence manifest from this environment.
